packageRules.description: rust-version is a bare MSRV string with nowhere to hang a digest. docker:pinDigests matches on the docker datasource, so without this it queues a pinDigest update the regex below can never write, and the branch errors out on every run.

customManagers.description: Keep Cargo.toml's rust-version in lockstep with the builder image tag. Same depName and datasource as the Dockerfile's rust image, so both land in one PR.
